text:
miriam.k: quick q — planning to flip speculative_decoding_v2 for gptx-1 in prod canary (5%). want ops handoff + guardrail checklist before we touch prod. short plan below, please ack and call out anything missing. :wave:

raj.s: ack. couple clarifying q's: is canary scoped by % only or by customer tier/region too? also need to confirm KV cache mode compatibility (sticky vs ephemeral).

miriam.k: canary = 5% global but limited to us-west-2 for the first hour. include free + standard tiers only. KV cache should stay in sticky mode for now — speculative decode + ephemeral KV had a weird token-repeat flake in staging yesterday.

raj.s: ok. propose these guardrails:
- start at 5% in us-west-2, 1h soak
- metrics to watch: token_p95_latency, request_error_rate, model_token_repeat_rate
- auto rollback triggers: p95 latency increase > 30ms OR error_rate delta > 0.5% OR token_repeat_rate > 0.2% absolute

miriam.k: +1. adding the minimal rollout config below so ops can mirror it.

```yaml
feature_flag:
  name: speculative_decoding_v2
  model: gptx-1
  scope:
    canary_pct: 5
    region: us-west-2
    tiers: [free, standard]
  kv_cache_mode: sticky
  rollout_strategy: linear(5% -> 100% over 8h)
  rollback_on:
    - token_p95_latency_increase_ms: 30
    - request_error_rate_delta_pct: 0.5
    - token_repeat_rate_absolute: 0.2
```

dean: i'll own monitoring and alerts. i'll create a short dashboard with p50/p95 token latency, error rate, and a custom "repeat token" metric. will attach runbook.

nora: can we add a small prompt-eval set (50 prompts) that exercises long-context behavior? if we see hallucination/regression we'll need to roll back even if latency looks good. i'll drop the list into the rollout ticket.

miriam.k: thanks, nora. i'll link the evals in the ticket and tag the QA cohort.

opsbot: Flag "speculative_decoding_v2" created in staging by miriam.k at 2026-03-17T10:12:00Z. Current state: disabled. Environment: staging.

raj.s: once dean confirms dashboards and ops has the runbook, i'll run the CLI canary flip. anticipated command: 

```bash
redwoodctl flags set speculative_decoding_v2 --enable --audience=canary:5 --region=us-west-2 --tiers=free,standard
```

miriam.k: plan: staging smoke -> small internal prod canary (5%) -> 1h soak -> expand to 25% if clean -> remaining 100% over 8h. rollback immediate on guardrail triggers. ccing @dean for SRE watch. :eyes:

dean: i'll be on watch during the canary window. creating alert: 
- name: spec-decoding-p95-regression
- trigger: token_p95_latency > baseline_p95 + 30ms for 5m
- action: pager + slack #eng-runtime-alerts
runbook: https://internal/runbooks/spec-decoding-rollout (will create shortly)

sre-bot: scheduled check-in reminder set for 30 minutes after canary start.

raj.s: quick note — keep a manual guard: if KV cache hits drop > 10% we should suspend canary. sticky mode should avoid this but let's watch it.

miriam.k: perfect. i'll open the rollout PR and add links to the dashboard/runbook/eval. tagging this thread for async approvals. ping here once dashboards exist and opsbot confirms prod flag creation. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
